text:
ben: Quick heads-up 1: Velox Systems kickoff 11:00am. They asked for a 48h POC to validate migration from VeloxAPI. Main asks: function/tool-call parity (Velox uses inline markers), streaming chunk parity, short reserved pricing vs hosted burst, and completed security questionnaire (SSO/SAML, FIPS-compatible KMS, VPC peering, audit retention). cc @olivia @raj @megan

olivia: I can prototype an adapter. VeloxAPI emits inline tokens like ((CALL:notify user=42)). Plan: detect pattern, parse args, emit structured tool call. Prototype by EOD. Keep toggleable.

raj: I'll run a 250-prompt diff with mixed cases: short chat, long instruction, multi-tool sequences, streaming-edge examples. Two modes: default sampling and deterministic (temp=0 + strict stops). Will capture token deltas, p50/p99 latency, and sample before/after pairs. ETA ~5h for first CSV.

megan: Security form created: https://redwood.example.com/secforms/velox-2394. Key asks: SSO (SAML + SCIM), BYO/FIPS KMS support, VPC peering, audit logs >=180d, SOC2. Legal will need to review KMS attachments.

security-bot: KMS handling doc attached: https://redwood.example.com/enterprise/kms-playbook (customer wants key-wrapping + no plaintext persist).

ben: Pricing for presales slide: need hosted per-token vs two-week dedicated trial pro-forma. Also they asked breakout: gen tokens vs embeddings vs request overhead.

billing: Quick slide numbers: hosted gen $0.0155/1k tokens, embeddings $0.0036/1k. Two-week dedicated trial (pro-rated for 2-node reserve) estimate ~$8.6k. I'll request formal quote from finance and post PO line. Also will include example invoice showing per-token and per-request lines.

raj: Early diff note (first 50 prompts): default -> ~13% token variance; deterministic -> ~2.9%. Streaming-edge cases (Velox chunked sentences) caused most p99 latency noise; normalizing streaming chunks and canonical stop tokens reduced variance by ~60%.

olivia: Adapter example for the POC deck (keeps parsing rules minimal): ```json
{
  "pattern": "^\\(\\(CALL:(.*?)\\)\\)",
  "map": "{ \"tool\": \"$2.name\", \"args\": parsed_args }"
}
``` We'll also strip Velox trailing chunk markers before diff.

megan: Legal/enterprise blocker: they require data residency clause and audit right. I'll loop in legal; expect 48-72h for contract language.

netops: We can provision VPC peering after CIDR + contact + billing code; typical turnaround ~24h after info provided.

ben: Owners summary: adapter=olivia, diff+reports=raj, pricing=billing, security/legal=megan, infra=netops. I'll lead customer comms and deck.

olivia: Will add 30 multi-tool prompts and 20 streaming-chunk edge cases to the 250 set. Also include one before/after example for the deck showing inline -> structured and token delta.

raj: Upload targets: https://redwood.example.com/pocs/velox-2394/diffs (CSV + sample pairs) and logs in the POC folder.

ben: Thanks all 1: reconvene after the first run. Quick request for the deck: include a single end-to-end example showing Velox original, mapped payload, and resulting Redwood response with latency & token delta.

netops: Ack. Ping with IPs and billing code when ready.

ben: :thumbsup:
